falsifier: Upgrade back toward PRIMARY_CONFIRMED only if Oman publishes an official confirmation of the governance/revenue terms or both governments release matching text. evidence.title: Reuters report on unresolved Iran-Oman Hormuz negotiations

title: Senior Iranian source says Hormuz governance deal is not finalized
summary: A senior Iranian source told Reuters that Iran and Oman are still negotiating the details of a Hormuz agreement, directly contradicting an IRGC spokesperson's earlier claim that governance and revenue-sharing agreements had already been reached. Shipping remains constrained, so the correct state is unresolved negotiations plus contested reopening, not a finalized governance accord.
delta: Supersede the earlier CLAIMED_GOVERNANCE_AGREEMENT interpretation with DISPUTED_NEGOTIATION_STATE. Preserve both Iranian claims in the graph, downgrade confidence in finalized governance/revenue terms, and require Omani primary confirmation or observable implementation before upgrading again.
firstOrderImpacts: reduce confidence in imminent implementation of new navigation fees, revenue-sharing or formal access rules
keep tanker, insurer and shipowner behavior anchored to physical-security and sanctions conditions rather than governance headlines
increase information value of official Omani confirmation and actual port/navigation notices
secondOrderImpacts: demonstrates that intra-state source disagreement can be more informative than cross-media repetition
strengthens Nexus temporal/supersession logic: authoritative-looking claims need versioned state and source lineage
reinforces the Alpha Hunter thesis that political narrative should be graded against operational telemetry

alphaHunter.hypothesis: Source-conflict plus operational telemetry will classify Hormuz governance state earlier and more accurately than treating the first official-sounding statement as final truth.
alphaHunter.baseline: latest public political statement about an Iran-Oman Hormuz agreement
alphaHunter.alternativeData: source lineage by institution, Omani primary releases, vessel throughput, navigation notices, fees/tolls, permission changes, freight and war-risk insurance
alphaHunter.incrementalValueMetric: time-to-correct-state classification and false-finalization rate over the next 3-7 days
alphaHunter.killCondition: Kill the extra source-conflict layer if it does not reduce false state transitions or improve timing versus simply waiting for joint official confirmation.
